description: Defines the PdfShadingPattern class which represents a shading pattern dictionary in a PDF, including methods to initialize it and set it up from a brush.

classes.name: PdfShadingPattern
classes.description: Represents a shading pattern in a PDF, allowing to set up shading from a brush and defining pattern dictionary keys.

classes.name: PdfShadingPattern.Keys
classes.description: Contains the dictionary keys used in the shading pattern dictionary, including type, pattern type, shading, matrix, and ext GState.

methods.name: PdfShadingPattern
methods.description: Constructor initializing a new shading pattern for a given PDF document.

methods.name: SetupFromBrush
methods.description: Configures the shading pattern from a specified brush, matrix, and renderer.
